At lines shown, when `auxiliary_device_add()` fails, it goes to `err_aux_dev_add`, which calls `auxiliary_device_uninit(adev)` (which invokes the release callback `idpf_vport_adev_release` freeing `iadev`). Then execution falls through to `err_aux_dev_init` which calls `ida_free(&idpf_idc_ida, adev->id)` on the already freed `adev->id` (use-after-free) and then falls through to `err_ida_alloc` which calls `kfree(iadev)` again (double free). The fix is not present.
